chunks: And Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in the muhrim undergoing cupping, so long as he does not shave or pluck the hair.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is cupping permissible for a muhrim during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim during ihram. It permits cupping for the muhrim, provided that no shaving or removal of hair takes place in the process.
